thread.en: They are fundamentally a 'rebirth' team. They haven't really faced any strong teams until now, and making it this far after playing HLE in a BO1 is actually quite impressive. I don't know why there's so much hype around IG, but as a fan of Tian, making it this far this year is way beyond my expectations. After the second stage, I thought this IG team was going to disband. GEN's discipline is just too good. Look at that last play, Gnar had 80 rage, GEN spread out, and once the rage was about to expire, Nautilus just hooked and went all-in. They play like AI. The only way IG could win is if one of the three lanes absolutely stomps their opponent and radiates pressure into the jungle. They can't win through small-scale skirmishes or macro against GEN. GEN's draft was designed to shut down their bot lane. No choice, just outclassed by too much.

top.en: I've always said IG had no chance of going further. TheShy is just trash now, stop looking at him through rose-colored glasses. Not to mention playing against Canyon; the gameplay isn't even in the same tier. To put it bluntly, he got stomped. A huge jungle gap. Meiko didn't face Keria this game, but if he did, he'd get stomped too. JiaQi has potential, but he loves to go crazy. When facing good defense, he easily gives up opportunities. Still too young. This team has no hope; not a single position is top-tier. The only one barely top-tier is JiaQi, but young players have their own shortcomings, and he still needs to be downgraded a tier.
